materialSettings.heightUsage: bump-only micro relief; not planetary terrain elevation

sourceResolution: PC source tier, packed into 96px-per-material cells (576×672 total) as a 43KB WebP atlas to reduce first-load transfer
notes: Atlas cells are cropped into independent CanvasTextures at runtime.
Base Color and Emissive are loaded as sRGB; Normal, Roughness, AO and Height are loaded as linear.
The original large-scale biome masks are not part of this compact runtime atlas; the first ground scene places biomes procedurally.
